description.p: Simple MD Reader opens and reads markdown files. It shows the text of the file as it is written down, keeps the headings in a list beside it, and lets you search through the text.
It opens .md, .markdown, .mdown, .mkd and .mdx files. A file can be opened from the file picker, by dropping it on the window, from the clipboard, or from the file manager of the system.

ul.li: Lists the headings of the document beside the text
Remembers what was read, so a document is easy to find again
Chooses the colours of the text and of the page, and keeps them between sessions
Never writes to the file: the reader only reads
